THE QUICK START

Keep the shop flowing.

  1. Pick a ticket. Grab its billet.Click an order card to select it, then use the Material rack. A SELECTED badge shows which job you are starting. In Manager and Owner, program each job at the office before cutting.
  2. Follow the ticket’s route.Load a machine, leave it running, then collect the finished part. A green label means it is ready.
  3. Inspect it. Ship it. Repeat.Complex parts earn more. Each second saved earns 4 bonus points. Ship on time to build a streak. Park a part on the Hold bench to free your hands.

Click the floor to walk, or click a station to walk over and use it. Owner calls interrupt handoffs. Answer at the office and stay for the three-second call, then accept the rush bonus or keep the original promise. Machines and deadlines keep running. Optional Wire EDM jobs cannot run on these machines. Choose Outsource with Covari, then click the Office computer for a small points bonus, or pass with no penalty. Partner deliveries do not count toward stars. Stuck with full hands? Return a part to Material to recycle it and restart its route.
